messages:
maria: Anyone else seeing paged alerts from eu-prod not hit oncall? Support says PD alerts didn't fire around 10:22 UTC.

ajay: I can confirm — incident-bot logs show deliveries marked SUPPRESSED with reason 'missing routing header'.

opsbot: incident-bot: delivery suppressed for 7 events; reason=missing X-Alert-Route; window=10:20:12-10:24:58 UTC

leo: Was there an ingress change around that time? I see an ingress rollout at 10:15 in infra-deploy.

sarah: Yep — rolled a k8s ingress config (preserve-forwarded-headers=false) to fix a different proxy issue. Oops, looks like that stomped our custom X-* headers. Rolling back now.

ajay: From the alert-router access logs (snippet):
```
"GET /v1/alerts HTTP/1.1" 200 - headers: Host: alert-router.internal
User-Agent: alertd/2.1
Accept: */*
# NOTE: no X-Alert-Route, no X-Service-Id
```

ben: We rely on X-Alert-Route for direct PD routing. incident-bot fallback to service-id was disabled in config (opt-in) after last year's rewrite.

maria: Ops oncall is live — are we able to temporarily page manually? Which teams impacted?

ops-oncall: I'm paged in and starting manual escalations. Created PD incident PD-12345 for the first customer report. Manually notified eng oncall for 'inference-runtime' and 'notify-gateway'.

ajay: Short mitigation that I can push now: enable legacy_fallback=true in incident-bot config so missing X-Alert-Route falls back to X-Service-Id and direct maps. Patching in 2m.

leo: Also will restart alert-router after rollback so it picks up preserved headers. Rolling restart now — ~30s window.

incident-bot: NOTE: delivery fallback disabled; to re-enable run:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://infra-api.internal/config/incident-bot -d '{"legacy_fallback": true}'
```

ben: I'll update runbook: When header-stripping happens, sequence is rollback ingress -> enable legacy_fallback -> restart alert-router -> verify deliveries -> create PD incident if customers impacted.

sarah: Customer impact: Support logged 2 customers with missed critical pages; both had manual paging started at 10:27 and acknowledged by teams by 10:39. I'll collect timelines and open customer notifications as needed.

ajay: Pushed config toggle and incident-bot picked it up. Confirmed deliveries retried; incident-bot shows 7 retried deliveries and 5 successful pages after fallback enabled.

maria: Good. Can someone capture the exact diff in the ingress change so we can avoid this in the future? Also assign postmortem owner.

leo: Diff is small — changed ingress template: preserve_forwarded_headers: false -> true. I'll add the diff to the ticket.

ben: I'll own the postmortem and runbook updates. ETA for draft: EOD.

sarah: Adding owners and initial timeline to the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1777777777

maria: Thanks all. Please add any missed customer mentions. We'll follow up with retro and a change to make incident-bot tolerant of missing headers (fall back automatically). :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Summary: suppressed deliveries=7; retried after fallback=7; successful pages=5; affected services=[inference-runtime, notify-gateway]; pd_incidents=[PD-12345]; postmortem_owner=ben
